text:
maria: Quick pivot from 'waterfall' idea  thinking a stacked-band latency chart (p50/p90/p99 bands) + a small sparkline of $/token under each model. Cleaner for mobile social and still tells the tradeoff story.

alex: stacked-band + sparkline sounds good. can we also include a tiny panel showing typical throughput (reqs/s) per config? ops teams ask that.

maria: Yes. keep the hero messaging focused: product teams want predictable tail and predictable spend. Also propose gated whitepaper download on the webinar landing.
sam: Data ask: eng/runtime please export CSV: model, p50_ms, p90_ms, p99_ms, cost_per_token_usd, throughput_rps, cache_flag. benchbot: attaching run 6189: https://bench.internal/runs/6189/summary

benchbot: run 6189 ready, models=[redwood-compact, redwood-core, open-large], fields included.
nora: Copy angle suggestion: emphasize "production predictability" rather than just speed. examples: 
- "Reduce surprises: latency & cost in production"
- "Understand production slippage before it hits your SLA"
Which is better for the landing?
liv: First line is clearer to customers; second can be a subhead under chart.

maria: Signup routing: form asks product interest (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Route to Enterprise SDR if product_interest IN (Dedicated, Private) OR company_size > 500. Otherwise go to marketing nurture. Also add hidden tag if they request "bench data" in the free-form field.
alex: For social creative, test two CTAs: "See the data" (low friction) vs "Get the whitepaper" (gated). A/B them.
sam: Figma notes for the chart frame: X axis = model variants; bands = p50 (light), p90 (mid), p99 (dark); below each band show sparkline of cost_per_token and tiny throughput badge. Micro-copy callouts: "Prefix cache reduces median latency by ~30%" and "Routing keeps p99 predictable".
maria: Timeline: mock by Tuesday AM, final assets Wed EOD. Owners: sam=chart + CSV, liv=copy + gated CTAs, alex=landing + routing, nora=whitepaper draft. I'll collect final copy in #content-review.
liv: Draft social lines (fresh):
A: "How predictable is your model in production? See data from real runs."
B: "Latency bands and token cost: practical examples for product teams."
C: "Want the full charts? Join our webinar or download the whitepaper."

maria: Great. add small compliance footnote: "Benchmarks in controlled environment; results depend on workload." Keep language neutral.

sam: I'll upload CSV + a first PNG to the thread by Monday.
maria: Thanks team. aim for clarity over cleverness on the visual; product leads should get actionable signals at a glance. :sparkles:
